items.name: Abyssal Blade
actives:
Overwhelm: Stuns a target enemy unit for 1.6 seconds. 

Pierces Debuff Immunity.
Bash: Grants melee heroes a 25% chance on hit to stun the target for 1.2 seconds and deal 120 bonus physical damage. Bash chance for ranged heroes is 10%.
items.why: Active stun that pierces debuff immunity + passive bash. Lock a BKB'd or blinking target.
items.when: Melee carries vs escape heroes (QoP, Storm, Puck) or BKB carries.

items.name: Aeon Disk
items.actives: Combo Breaker: When you take damage and your health falls below 70%, a strong dispel is applied and you gain a 2.5 second buff that provides +75% Status Resistance and causes all damage you deal and are dealt to be reduced to zero. Only triggers on player based damage. Cooldown increases every time it triggers.Dispel Type: Strong Dispel
items.why: Strong dispel + 2.5s of near immunity when you drop low. Stops burst combos.
items.when: Vs burst lineups (Lion/Lina/Tinker style). Bad vs sustained physical.

items.name: Aghanim's Shard
items.actives: Ability Upgrade: Upgrades an existing ability or adds a new ability to your hero.
items.why: Cheap ability upgrade, bought from the shop after ~15 min.
items.when: Usually bought around 15-25 min when it fits the hero.

items.name: Armlet of Mordiggian
items.actives:
Unholy Strength: When active, Unholy Strength grants +35 damage, +25 strength and +4 armor, but drains 45 health per second.

 You cannot die from the health drain when Unholy Strength is activated, nor from the strength loss when Unholy Strength is deactivated.

items.name: Assault Cuirass
items.actives:
Assault Aura: Grants 30 attack speed and 5 armor to nearby allied units and structures, and decreases nearby enemy unit and structure armor by -5.

Radius: 1200
items.why: Armor aura for team and -armor aura on enemies. Huge in push fights.
items.when: Late game carries vs physical lineups, or to siege high ground.

items.name: Skull Basher
items.actives: Bash: Grants melee heroes a 25% chance on hit to stun the target for 1.2 seconds and deal 100 bonus physical damage. Bash chance for ranged heroes is 10%.
items.why: Cheap bashes. Builds into Abyssal Blade.
items.when: Melee carries who fight a lot.

items.name: Battle Fury
actives: Chop Tree: Destroy a target tree.
Quell: Increases attack damage against non-hero units by 10 for melee heroes, and 5 for ranged.
Cleave: Deals 60% of attack damage as physical damage in a cone up to 650 around the target. Deals 40% against creeps. (Melee Only)
items.why: Cleave turns every creep wave/camp into one-hit clears; the regen keeps you farming without base trips.
items.when: AM and some melee carries in long games. Skip if you need to fight immediately.

items.name: Black King Bar
items.actives:
Avatar: Applies a basic dispel. Grants 60% magic resistance and immunity to reflected and pure damage. For the duration of the effect, any negative effect from enemy spells has no effect. 

Duration: 9s 
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
items.why: Debuff immunity: most disables and magic damage stop affecting you. The #1 'stay alive in fights' item.
items.when: Vs several stuns/silences or big magic damage. Buy it BEFORE you think you need it.

items.name: Blink Dagger
items.actives:
Blink: Teleport to a target point up to 1200 units away. 

Blink Dagger cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
items.why: Instant 1200 range reposition.
items.when: Heroes without built-in mobility (WK sometimes).

items.name: Blitz Knuckles
items.why: Cheap attack speed component (MKB, Shadow Blade path).
items.when: Component.

items.name: Bloodthorn
actives:
Soul Rend: Silences a target for 5 seconds. At the end of the silence, an additional 60% of all damage taken during the silence will be dealt to the target as magical damage.

All attacks on the silenced target will deal additional damage equal to 50 if the attacker is a hero, and 25, if the attacker is a creep. Provides True Strike for your attacks and attacks from your controlled units against the silenced target.
Pierce: Grants each attack a 40% chance to pierce through evasion and deal 60 bonus magical damage.
items.why: Silence that amplifies damage + pierce-evasion chance + attack speed.
items.when: Vs evasion carries or a key spellcaster you must shut down.

items.name: Iron Branch
items.actives: Plant Tree: Targets the ground to plant a happy little tree that lasts for 20 seconds.

items.name: Butterfly
items.why: Agility, attack speed, evasion. Enemies miss a third of their hits.
items.when: Agility carries vs physical cores WITHOUT MKB/Bloodthorn.

items.name: Consecrated Wraps
items.actives:
Hallowed: Gain a stack every 3s, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. Upon gaining a stack, your movement speed is increased by 20% for 7s.

Whenever you take damage from a player-controlled unit or Roshan, consume all stacks to gain an all damage barrier for 7s that absorbs 120 damage per stack (360 max).
items.why: Spell resistance + stats + HP + move speed stacks. Cheaper anti-magic option.
items.when: Second-tier defensive vs magic before BKB.

items.name: Desolator
actives: Corruption: Your attacks reduce the target's armor by -6 for 7 seconds.
Soul Stealer: Desolator gains +2 damage every time an enemy hero dies while affected by Corruption, to a maximum of 30.
items.why: -6 armor on hit = big physical amplification, kills towers fast.
items.when: PA, TA, high-damage carries that hit hard per attack.

items.name: Diffusal Blade
actives: Inhibit: Targets an enemy, slowing it for 4 seconds.

Manabreak: Each attack burns 40 mana from the target, and deals 1 physical damage per burned mana. 

Illusions do not burn mana.
items.why: Mana burn on hit (illusions burn too) + slow active. Shuts off INT heroes.
items.when: PL, illusion carries, or vs mana-dependent supports. Upgrades to Disperser.

items.name: Disperser
actives:
Suppress: Dispels both the wearer and the target. Enemy targets are slowed for 5 seconds. Allied targets gain bonus movespeed and 40% slow resistance for 5 seconds. Caster is always granted the ally benefit on cast.

Both movement speed reduction and increase start at 100% and gradually decrease to 0% over the course of the buff duration.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

Manabreak: Each attack burns 40 mana from the target, and deals 1 physical damage per burned mana. 

Illusions do not burn mana.
items.why: Diffusal upgrade: strong dispel on self or ally + slow on enemy. Big agility.
items.when: Late game when enemies have many dispellable slows/silences.

items.name: Dragon Lance
items.why: Cheap attack range + stats for ranged heroes.
items.when: Ranged agility carries; upgrade to Hurricane Pike.

items.name: Eternal Shroud
actives: Shroud: Restores mana equal to 25% of incoming enemy spell damage before reductions.

Eternal Endurance: For every 300 spell damage that equipped hero receives, it gains a stack of Endurance for 5s up to a maximum of 6 charges. Each charge increases Eternal Shroud's magic resistance by 3.5% .
items.why: Spell resistance, HP, and mana restore from spell damage.
items.when: Vs heavy magic lineups if BKB is not enough or as a second defensive.

items.name: Ethereal Blade
items.actives:
Ether Blast: Converts the target unit to ethereal form, rendering them immune to physical damage, but unable to attack and -30% more vulnerable to magic damage.

 Enemy targets are also slowed by -80%, and take 1x the sum of all your attributes + 50 as magical damage.
Duration: 4 seconds
items.why: Agility + makes target ethereal (amplified magic damage, can't attack).
items.when: Morphling's classic burst item with Adaptive Strike.

items.name: Faerie Fire
items.actives: Imbue: Instantly restores 85 health.

items.name: Falcon Blade
items.why: HP, mana regen, damage. Keeps spell-reliant carries topped up.
items.when: Spell carries (SF, Morph early) who want to fight before core items.

items.name: Daedalus
items.actives: Critical Strike: Grants each attack a 30% chance to deal 225% damage.
items.why: Daedalus: 30% chance for 225% damage. Scales with high base damage.
items.when: Damage-heavy carries (PA has her own crit, so less common on her).

items.name: Gleipnir
items.actives: Eternal Chains: Roots all enemies in a 350 radius for 2 seconds.
items.why: Maelstrom + AoE root active. Catches heroes in fights.
items.when: Arc Warden / ranged carries vs slippery heroes.

items.name: Hand of Midas
items.actives:
Transmute: Kills a non-hero target for 160 gold. Killing a neutral creep additionally grants a madstone bundle. 

 Cannot be used on Ancient creeps.
items.why: Converts a creep into gold + XP every ~90s. Pays for itself in ~10-12 min.
items.when: Only if the lane is safe and the game will go long. Weak in fast games.

items.name: Harpoon
actives: Draw Forth: When targeting an enemy, fire a harpoon at them, that pulls you and the target closer together, up to 35% of the distance between you and your target. If the caster is melee, the hero and target are always pulled to within melee distance of each other. Targeting a tree always pulls you all the way to that tree.
Echo Strike: Causes melee attacks to attack twice in quick succession. The double attacks apply a 100% movement slow for 1 seconds on the first strike. Echo Strike cooldown: 5s
items.why: Pulls you and the enemy together + Echo Strike double hits.
items.when: Melee STR carries who need to stick to kiting targets.

items.name: Heart of Tarrasque
items.actives: Behemoth's Blood: Your health regeneration is increased by 1.5% of your missing health.
items.why: Massive HP and regen that scales with missing HP.
items.when: Strength carries who must survive long fights.

items.name: Hurricane Pike
items.actives:
Hurricane Thrust: Pushes you and target enemy 425 units away from each other, and for 6 seconds, allows you to make 5 attacks against the target without range restrictions and with +100 attack speed.

Can be cast on self or allies to push the target 600 units in the direction it is facing.
Enemy Range: 425
items.why: Range + stats + disengage that still lets you attack the target.
items.when: Ranged carries vs divers (Arc, TA, SF late).

items.name: Hydra's Breath
actives: Miasma: Attacks poison enemies, dealing 2.5% of the target's Max HP as Magical Damage per second for 3 seconds.

Polycephaly: Ranged attacks have a 30% chance to fire additional projectiles at up to 3 nearby enemies with 150 extra range and within a 120 degree angle in front of the attacker. The additional projectiles deal 20 + 75% damage of a normal attack and do not trigger on hit effects except for Miasma. The primary attack deals 20 + 100% damage of a normal attack.
items.why: Ranged multi-shot + %HP poison. Late-game AoE right clicks.
items.when: Ranged agility carries late (Medusa, Gyro, Drow...).

items.name: Morbid Mask
items.actives: Lifesteal: Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.

items.name: Maelstrom
items.actives: Chain Lightning: Grants a 25% chance on attack to release a bolt of electricity that leaps between 4 targets within a 650 radius, dealing 110 magical damage to each. Lightning proc pierces evasion.
items.why: Chain lightning clears waves and procs on illusions/Tempest Double attacks.
items.when: Arc Warden, ranged/agi carries who farm with right clicks.

items.name: Magic Stick
items.actives:
Energy Charge: Instantly restores 15 health and mana per charge stored.

 Max 10 charges. Gains a charge whenever a visible enemy within 1200 range uses an ability.
items.why: Charges whenever enemies cast spells near you. A burst of HP/MP that wins trades.
items.when: Against spell-spammy lanes (Bristleback, Batrider, Timbersaw, most supports).

items.name: Magic Wand
items.actives:
Energy Charge: Instantly restores 15 health and mana per charge stored. 

Max 20 charges. Gains a charge whenever a visible enemy within 1200 range uses an ability.

items.name: Manta Style
items.actives:
Mirror Image: Creates 2 images of your hero that last 18 seconds. 

Melee images deal 33% damage, while Ranged images deal 28%. Illusions take 300% damage. 

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
items.why: Stats + 2 illusions + basic dispel on yourself. Illusions double farm speed and confuse targeting.
items.when: AM, PL, Morph, TB style agility carries. Dispels silences (Orchid, Bloodthorn) and roots.

items.name: Mask of Madness
actives: Berserk: Gives 100 attack speed, 8% / 12% movement speed (ranged/melee), and 30% slow resistance, but reduces your armor by 7 and silences you. Lasts 6 seconds.
Lifesteal: Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.
items.why: Lifesteal + attack speed burst. Fast farm on attack-speed heroes.
items.when: TA, Troll, Sven style. Watch out: the active silences you.

items.name: Mjollnir
actives: Static Charge: Places a charged shield on a target unit for 15 seconds which has a 20% chance to release a 225 magical damage shocking bolt at a nearby attacker and 4 additional enemies.
Chain Lightning: Grants a 25% chance on attack to release a bolt of electricity that leaps between 12 targets within a 650 radius, dealing 180 magical damage to each. Lightning proc pierces evasion.
items.why: Upgraded Maelstrom: huge attack speed + more bounce targets. Strong vs illusions and summons.
items.when: Mid-game DPS upgrade for Maelstrom users.

items.name: Monkey King Bar
items.actives: Pierce: Grants each attack a 80% chance to pierce through evasion and deal 70 bonus magical damage.
items.why: Pierces evasion (80% chance) + bonus magic damage.
items.when: Vs Butterfly, PA (Immaterial), Windranger, TA's Refraction is NOT evasion.

items.name: Nullifier
items.actives:
Nullify: Dispels the target and applies a debuff for 4 seconds. Continuously dispels and slows the target.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
items.why: Continuously dispels the target: removes Ghost Scepter, Glimmer, Eul's, Aeon's buff.
items.when: Vs saves and ethereal tricks.

items.name: Orb of Corrosion
items.actives: Corrosion: Your attacks reduce the target's armor by -2, slows their movement by -16% (-8% against melee targets), and reduces Health Restoration by 16%. Lasts for 3 seconds.
items.why: Armor reduction + slow + heal reduction on hit. Makes melee carries win lane trades and chases.
items.when: Melee carries vs healing/regen heroes or when you need to stick to targets.

items.name: Orchid Malevolence
items.actives: Soul Burn: Silences the target unit for 5 seconds. At the end of the silence, 30% of the damage received while silenced is inflicted as bonus magical damage.
items.why: Silence. Shuts down an escape or spellcaster.
items.when: Vs slippery spellcasters; upgrades to Bloodthorn.

items.name: Phase Boots
items.actives: Phase: Gives 20% increased movement speed on melee heroes, and 10% on ranged heroes, and lets you move through units and turn more quickly for 3 seconds.
items.why: Damage + armor + an active speed burst. Better for heroes who must stick to targets.
items.when: Aggressive melee carries (WK, PA sometimes) vs kiting heroes.

items.name: Power Treads
items.actives: Switch Attribute: Switches between +10 Strength, +10 Agility, or +10 Intelligence.
items.why: Attack speed + switchable stat. Tread switching (INT before casting, STR/AGI after) is free mana.
items.when: Default boots on most farming carries.

items.name: Quelling Blade
actives: Chop Tree: Destroy a target tree.
Quell: Increases attack damage against non-hero units by 8 for melee heroes, and 4 for ranged.
items.why: Bonus damage vs creeps = easier last hits for melee carries. Sell or fold into Battle Fury.
items.when: Default start on melee carries; ranged often skip.

items.name: Radiance
items.actives:
Burn: When active, scorches enemies for 60 magical damage per second. Illusions deal 35 magical damage per second.

Radius: 650
items.why: Constant AoE burn that farms by walking + evasion. Illusions also burn (weaker).
items.when: PL/Naga style illusion carries when they want to fight early, or vs illusion-heavy enemies.

items.name: Refresher Orb
items.actives: Reset Cooldowns: Resets the cooldowns of all your abilities. Shares a cooldown with Refresher Shard. This item's cooldown only progresses in your hero's main inventory.
items.why: Resets ultimates and item cooldowns.
items.when: SF (double Requiem), Arc (double everything).

items.name: Ring of Health
items.why: Big HP regen for the price. Start of Battle Fury / Perseverance.
items.when: AM and Battle Fury carries, first item after boots.

items.name: Sange and Yasha
items.why: Stats + status/slow resistance + move speed. A cheaper 'fight item'.
items.when: Melee carries vs slows and disables when BKB is too slow to get.

items.name: Satanic
actives:
Unholy Rage: Increases Lifesteal percentage to 175% for 6 seconds. 

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
Lifesteal: Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.
items.why: Strength + huge lifesteal active with basic dispel. Turns a losing fight around.
items.when: Melee physical carries late (WK, PA, Sven). Bad vs break/heal reduction.

items.name: Scythe of Vyse
items.actives:
Hex: Turns a target unit into a harmless critter for 2.8 seconds. The target has a base movement speed of 140 and will be silenced, muted, and disarmed.
Instantly destroys illusions.

items.name: Silver Edge
items.actives:
Shadow Walk: Makes you invisible for 17 seconds, or until you attack or cast a spell. While invisible, you move 25% faster and can move through units. 

Attacking to end the invisibility will deal 300 bonus physical damage, disable their passive abilities for 5 seconds, and cap their movement speed to 200.
items.why: Invisibility initiation + Break (disables passives).
items.when: Vs passive-reliant heroes (PA Immaterial, Bristleback, Spectre, Huskar, WK Reincarnation!).

items.name: Eye of Skadi
items.actives: Cold Attack: Attacks lower enemy movement by -25% if they are melee and -50% if they are ranged. Attacks also lower enemy attack speed by -20% and Health Restoration by 50%. Lasts for 3 seconds.
items.why: Huge stats (HP + mana + damage) and a slow/heal reduction on attack.
items.when: AM, Morph, Medusa style carries vs kiting or healing teams.

items.name: Linken's Sphere
actives: Spellblock: Blocks most targeted spells once every 14 seconds.
Transfer Spellblock: Temporarily removes Spellblock from the item's owner and transfers it to an allied unit for 14 seconds.
items.why: Blocks one targeted spell every few seconds (Doom, Duel, Lasso, Hex...).
items.when: Vs single-target ultimates that BKB doesn't stop or that you must avoid.

items.name: Swift Blink
items.actives:
Swift Blink: Teleport to a target point up to 1200 units away.

After teleportation, you gain 40% phased movement speed and +35 Agility for 6 seconds. 

Swift Blink cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
items.why: Blink upgrade that gives agility + phased speed after blinking.
items.when: Late-game luxury slot on agility carries.

items.name: Tango
items.actives:
Devour: Consumes a target tree to gain 7 health regeneration for 16 seconds. Consuming an Ironwood Tree doubles the heal duration.

Comes with 3 charges. Can be used on an allied hero to give them one Tango.

Tree Range: 165
items.why: Cheapest sustain in the game. Eating a tree also gives vision paths.
items.when: Always.

items.name: Boots of Travel
items.actives: Town Portal Scroll: Upgrades your Town Portal Scroll, allowing it to target units, reduces cooldown and does not consume a charge on usage.

items.name: Aghanim's Scepter
items.actives: Ability Upgrade: Upgrades the ultimate, and some abilities, of all heroes.
items.why: Aghanim's: changes or upgrades a hero ability (hero-specific).
items.when: Check the hero page; for some carries it is core (WK, Morph sometimes), for others skip.

items.name: Witch Blade
items.actives: Witch Blade: Causes your next attack to apply a poison for 4 seconds, slowing by 25% and dealing 0.75x your intelligence as damage every second. This attack has True Strike.
items.why: Poison + slow + armor on INT-scaling attack. Upgrades to Parasma.
items.when: Arc Warden style INT/AGI right clickers.

items.name: Wraith Band
items.why: Stats, attack speed, armor for 500ish gold. Most efficient early agility item.
items.when: Agility carries when the lane is contested; one is usually enough.

items.name: Yasha
items.why: Agility, attack speed, move speed. Builds into Manta / S&Y.
items.when: Component.
